inventory.sourceFigureDescription: Line-art flowchart whose nodes carry ~98 small monochrome cell-cluster rasters (50-90 px at 308 ppi, one per node — VLM census documented: more cells, bigger cells, shrunken cells, changed type, disordered cells, disordered mass). Topology VLM-verified: Normal cells at center; green arrows up to Hyperplasia/Hypertrophy/Atrophy ('Change in cell size and/or number'); green arrows down to Dysplasia ('Change in cell structure') and Metaplasia ('Change in cell type'); red arrow to Neoplasia ('Change in cell type and structure'); red 'Inability to adapt' and 'Severe stress or injury' into the terminal box 'Irreversible injury → necrosis or apoptosis'; red 'If chronic irritant persists' Dysplasia → Neoplasia; legend green = Reversible, red = Irreversible. No photographs.
